Renovation Cost in Dubai 2026

Renovating a home in Dubai in 2026 costs between AED 500 and AED 1,500 per square foot, depending on the finish level, the scope of work involved, and whether structural changes are required. Labor and materials together account for the majority of the total budget.

How much does a villa renovation cost?

A full villa renovation ranges from AED 400,000 to AED 1.2M according to platform project data. This includes all rooms, flooring, and kitchen and bathroom upgrades across a typical four-bedroom villa in Dubai.

What affects the price?

Several factors influence the final renovation budget in Dubai, including the quality of materials chosen, the contractor experience level, and the complexity of the design. Projects with imported materials typically cost 30 to 50 percent more than locally sourced alternatives.

  • Finish level
  • Structural changes
  • Material origin
  • Contractor tier

How long does a renovation take?

A standard apartment renovation in Dubai takes four to eight weeks. Larger villa projects can run three to six months depending on scope and permit approvals from Dubai Municipality.
